response.overview: Wrestle Odyssey II was a professional wrestling event promoted by Pro Wrestling NOAH, held on October 25, 2026 at Ryōgoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan. The second annual event under the "Wrestle Odyssey" name, Tetsuya Naito defended the GHC Heavyweight Championship against the winner of the 2026 N-1 Victory tournament in the main event.
response.title: Getworks Presents WRESTLE ODYSSEY Ⅱ
